name: Jausenstation Schärmeralm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Schärmeralm Jausenstation in Tirol!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, this cozy mountain hut offers a perfect stop for hikers, skiers, and nature lovers. Enjoy hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Käse** (cheese), and homemade **Apfelstrudel** while taking in breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks.

Whether you're refueling after a long trek or seeking a warm retreat, the **Schärmeralm** promises authentic **Tiroler** hospitality and delicious flavors. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, it’s the ideal spot to experience the best of **Tirol’s** alpine culture.

**Come visit us—your taste buds and soul will thank you!**
